target: Validate a claim about self correction using an error-detection and repair trace. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

competency.title: Validate self correction — few shot
competency.outcome: Validate a claim about self correction using an error-detection and repair trace. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

topic_kernel.measure: net correction gain and new-error rate
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: changing a correct answer without evidence

competency.practice_task: Produce a preregistered test protocol and evidence record grounded in an error-detection and repair trace.
competency.setting_constraint: Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
required_evidence: a preregistered test protocol and evidence record
Include the example count, selection rule and learning curve.
Report net correction gain and new-error rate with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: changing a correct answer without evidence.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of self correction.
Practice: a held-out challenge supports or rejects the claim.
Measurement: report net correction gain and new-error rate against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for changing a correct answer without evidence; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
